pages.title: The Ground Beneath the Saddle
pages.text: Turn accepted feeding into controlled temporary combat transport.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Look for Quake in desert terrain. Its temporary mount state and area strike belong to the native mechanic; owning cactus is not enough.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Cactus enables temporary riding; the mount’s separate action performs the area strike.
